name: Santa Marta de Magasca (Spain)
description: A white hoist part bearing the crowned municipal arms of Santa Marta de Magasca (crossed keys and a cross on red above waves), separated by a blue and white wavy line from a red fly.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Marta de Magasca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: vertical wavy stripe along the division
Santa Marta de Magasca arms — crossed keys and cross above waves
